title: 'House, M.D.' Star Responds After Bizarre AI Death Claims
key_facts: Meta AI produced text saying actress Lisa Edelstein, who played Dr Cuddy on House, died on 29 September 2026 at 60 from a car accident head injury
The text also described a wake at a Boston cemetery hosted by her older sister
Edelstein posted on social media that she is not dead, writing "I AM NOT DEAD"
She joked about the AI planning a Catholic wake for her, a Jew, and noted it had referenced her Rosh Hashanah post
Her post said she had a few more hours of daylight left to outlive the prediction, dating it to 29 Sep 2026
Fans replied with House jokes such as "Was it Lupus?"
quote_evidence: Lisa Edelstein, who played Cuddy on the show, took to social media to announce her own death. Well, to renounce it—in her words, "I AM NOT DEAD."

"Sadly, American actress Lisa Edelstein, known for her role as Dr. Lisa Cuddy on the medical drama series House, passed away on September 29, 2026 at the age of 60 due to a head injury from a car accident."
She ended the post, "I have a few more hours of daylight to outlive this prediction, so send good thoughts my way."
why_it_matters_hint: Another example of an AI assistant inventing a detailed, false fact about a real person
notes: Single outlet relaying the actress's own social media post; the Meta AI output is quoted from her screenshot, not independently reproduced.
